title: Audit a task import
prompt:
Row, AuditReport and the row readers are supplied. Write three methods.

1. public static AuditReport Summarize(List<Row> rows). A row is invalid when its Id is empty or its Title is empty. A valid row whose Id was already accepted is a duplicate. Every other row is accepted. Return the three counts and a Status: "empty" when there are no rows, "clean" when every row was accepted, and "review" otherwise. An invalid row does not use up its Id.

2. public static async Task<AuditReport> AuditAsync(IRowReader reader). Read the rows exactly once and return their summary. When the reader throws InvalidOperationException, return a report with the Status "unavailable" and three counts of 0.

3. public static bool SummarizeCheck(Func<List<Row>, AuditReport> candidate). A regression check for Summarize. Return true for a correct candidate, and false for a faulty one that counts duplicates as accepted.
hints: Work out the report by hand for three rows where the second repeats the first Id. What are the three counts?
Test whether a row is invalid before asking whether its Id was seen, and record an Id only when its row is accepted.
For the check, pass rows that contain a duplicate and compare the candidate's report with the exact report you worked out by hand.
checkLabels: Two valid rows with different Ids must give a clean report with 2 accepted.
No rows must give an empty report.
A row that repeats an accepted Id must be counted as 1 duplicate, not as accepted.
A row with an empty Id and a row with an empty Title must both be invalid.
Two rows with empty Ids are both invalid. Neither is a duplicate of the other.
An invalid row must not use up its Id for a later valid row.
AuditAsync must return the summary of the rows it read.
An unavailable reader must give the Status "unavailable" with three counts of 0.
AuditAsync must read the rows exactly once.
A correct candidate must pass your regression check.
A candidate that counts duplicates as accepted must fail your regression check.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts a repeated Id as accepted.
Asks whether the Id was seen before checking that the row is valid.
Reads once to test the reader and again to get the rows.
Checks only rows without a duplicate, so the faulty candidate passes.

feedback: Find the first failing check and work out its report by hand, one row at a time. Each row belongs to exactly one of the three counts.
